name: Café Konditorei Großgasteiger
kurzbeschreibung: **Café Konditorei Großgasteiger** in Innsbruck invites you to indulge in a world of refined Austrian pastries and traditional coffee culture. Nestled in the heart of the city, this historic café has been delighting visitors since 1895 with its elegant interiors and exquisite **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Apfelstrudel**, and **Sachertorte**. Whether you're savoring a morning **Melange** or an afternoon **Einspänner**, every sip and bite is a celebration of **Tirol**’s finest culinary traditions. Don’t miss their famous **Topfenstrudel**—a creamy, flaky masterpiece that’s pure comfort. A perfect stop for locals and travelers alike, this café blends old-world charm with the vibrant energy of Innsbruck’s city life.
